Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on task updates and coordination for ongoing marketing and website projects.
Key issues included pending YouTube ads, audience targeting responsibilities, and delays in website migration and content revamp.
Follow-up actions involved Mahesh sharing Christmas/New Year content, Harsha coordinating website migration, and Pawan connecting with Vijaya for content revamp.
Decisions were made to review pending tasks, establish clear timelines, and improve communication to enhance project coordination and completion.
